newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow, few sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow, few sales - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow. Few sales slaughter steers and heifers fully steady.
Inquiry and demand fair. Sales confirmed on 1300 slaughter steers and 300 slaughter heifers Friday.
This week's confirmed sales 118,200 head including 21,100 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1170 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 64.00.
